items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 3849.45/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-05-07 was Rs 3849.45/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 200.97-10000.0/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +129.2% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 8823.67/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 3849.45/MWh, a +129.2% divergence.

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Wide intraday MCP spread: 255% of daily average
items.detail: Max-min spread of Rs 10000.0 - Rs 200.97 = 255% of the daily average, indicating high intraday volatility.
